page0.text:
I'm dreaming.
It must because my blood is feverish, and my entire body is throbbing.
Something I'd rather not have to remember plays out in my dream.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page0:1

page1.text:
This is my oldest memory.
It's also a memory I can't escape.
It's a scene from ten years ago, and one I usually try not to think back on. I can't ever erase it from my memory though.
It's not that I forgot.
It's not even that I want to forget.
It's just that it's already happened.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page1:1

page2.text:
So it's not especially painful.
And I don't really feel all that angry about it either.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page2:1

page3.text:
The past is the past.
I can't return to it; I can't redo it.
All that happened is that I escaped, and lived on.
Looking forward is all I can do.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page3:1

page4.text:
Nobody told me to do that.
But I've thought about that, even if just vaguely, since I was a kid.
I can't forget or deny the past.
The only way to keep the memory of what we lost alive is to acknowledge it.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page4:1

page5.text:
"It's...hot."
I wake up to find my body is still burning up.
I must have wound up falling asleep out in the cool air last night.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page5:1

page6.text: Inside this dimly lit shed with me and—
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page6:1

page7.text:
"S-Saber!?"
"You've awoken, Shirou. I do not mind you sneaking away from your room, but I do not approve of you sleeping in a place like this."
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page7:1

page8.text: "Oh, morning. Well, I was burning up last night, and when I went outside, I got sleepy."
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page8:1

page9.text: "I can see that. You do not have to explain yourself, but please do be careful next time. My Master sleeping in such a place puts me in an awkward position."
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page9:1

page10.text:
"Ugh...sorry. I'll try to sleep in my own room next time."
"That would be very helpful, yes.
By the way, Shirou, Taiga has been calling for you for a while now."
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page10:1

page11.text:
"Fuji-nee? What's she want?"
"It may be about breakfast. It is long past breakfast time."
"Eh!? What, it's already past seven!? Crap...I overslept!"
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page11:1

page12.text:
"Yes. It is quite unusual for you to be the last to wake up. Your training with Rin last night must have affected you rather a lot."
Saber provides a calm analysis of the situation.
But I don't have time for idle chitchat.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page12:1

page13.text:
"I know you went out of your way to wake me up, but go on back ahead of me. I'll hurry up and get changed, then head to the kitchen."
"Very well. I will do what I can to calm Taiga down."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page13:1

page14.text:
Saber turns and heads back to the house.
Calm Fuji-nee? Saber sure has adapted well to our morning routine...
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page14:1

page15.text:
I dash to the kitchen.
I ignore Fuji-nee's jeers, and prepare breakfast as quickly as I can.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page15:1

page16.text:
"Sorry to keep you waiting. There's not much time before school starts, so hurry up and eat."
I plop breakfast onto the table.
"What...!?"
Suddenly...
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page16:1

page17.text:
"What the hell is this!?"
Fuji-nee explodes, practically spitting fire.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page17:1

page18.text: "What is this!? It's just toast! Shirou, why is this all there is for breakfast today!?"
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page18:1

page19.text: "Hey. I overslept. I don't have time to make anything else, and a breakfast with toast is typically just that. It's just missing salad and eggs, so there's not a huge difference."
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page19:1

page20.text:
"There's a BIG difference!
Everyone else agrees, right!?"
Fuji-nee tries to appeal to Saber and Tohsaka, who both eat in silence.
This isn't going to go in her favor.
Neither of them is as gluttonous as Fuji-nee. She's barking up the wrong tree.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page20:1

page21.text:
"She may be right. I'm not Miss Fujimura, but I don't know if I can tolerate such laziness. I can only assume you're insulting bread as a breakfast choice."
...Hey wait a minute.
I thought she didn't eat breakfast to begin with!?
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page21:1

page22.text:
"...Hnn..."
Now why's she sighing, all disappointed!? That's way out of character.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page22:1

page23.text:
"See? Everyone thinks you're in the wrong. Majority rules here, so you'd best think on what you've done, then make a proper breakfast for us."
"That's so unfair! Besides, if I start making a dish now, you're going to be late, Fuji-nee. It's already seven-thirty, so you need to do the whole running out of the house with a piece of toast hanging from your mouth thing! Give it up!"
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page23:1

page24.text:
"Fine. If I have to choose between being late or being hungry, I choose breakfast."
"That's nuts! What kind of teacher even are you!? Just eat your toast and go to school! I absolutely refuse to make anything else, even if it kills me!"
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page24:1

page25.text: "Geez, you really do get worked up over nothing. Keep talking like an old man, and you'll become one real quick."
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page25:1

page26.text:
"You don't need to remind me. Thanks to you, I'm practically an old man already."
I huff and take a bite of toast.
Okay, she...might be right.
There is something kind of sad about there being so many people here, and then only having toast for breakfast.
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-15:page26:1
